$ kubectl run web --image=nginx:1.27 --port=80 --env=MODE=prod --labels=app=web,tier=frontend
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod/web created
--- stderr

$ kubectl run web --image=nginx:1.27
--- exit 1 (CONFLICT)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (AlreadyExists): pods "web" already exists

$ kubectl run Web --image=nginx:1.27
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
The Pod "Web" is invalid: 
* metadata.name: Invalid value: "Web": a lowercase RFC 1123 subdomain must consist of lower case alphanumeric characters, '-' or '.', and must start and end with an alphanumeric character
* spec.containers[0].name: Invalid value: "Web"

$ kubectl run broken --image=ngnix:1.27
--- exit 0
--- stdout

--- stderr

$ kubectl run x --image=nginx:1.27 --restart=Never
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: --restart=Never isn't simulated: Pods in KubeDojo always restart their containers (--restart=Always)

$ kubectl run x -it --rm --image=busybox
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: -it isn't supported: no containers actually run in the simulator, so there is no shell to attach to. Create the Pod, then use kubectl logs and kubectl describe.

$ kubectl run x --image=busybox -- sleep 3600
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: container commands and arguments (--command, -- ARGS) aren't simulated: each image has a fixed behavior. Leave them out.

$ kubectl run x
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: required flag(s) "image" not set

$ kubectl run x --image=nginx:1.27 -n nope
--- exit 1 (NOT_FOUND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (NotFound): namespaces "nope" not found

$ kubectl run draft --image=nginx:1.27 --port=80 --dry-run=client -o yaml
--- exit 0
--- stdout
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  labels:
    run: draft
  name: draft
  namespace: default
spec:
  containers:
  - image: nginx:1.27
    name: draft
    ports:
    - containerPort: 80
    resources: {}
  restartPolicy: Always
status: {}
--- stderr

$ kubectl run draft --image=nginx:1.27 --dry-run=client
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod/draft created (dry run)
--- stderr

$ kubectl run draft --image=nginx:1.27 --dry-run=server
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: --dry-run=server isn't supported: there is no API server to ask; use --dry-run=client

$ kubectl get pod draft
--- exit 1 (NOT_FOUND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (NotFound): pods "draft" not found
